```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#| cache: true
#| message: false
wayback_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)
wayback_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

fetch_imdb_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  page <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  snapshot_table <- page |>
    html_table() |>
    pluck(1)

  rank_title <- str_squish(snapshot_table$`Rank & Title`)
  rank_title_parts <- str_match(
    rank_title,
    "^([0-9]+)\\.\\s*(.*?)\\s*\\(([0-9]{4})\\)$"
  )

  rating_nodes <- html_elements(page, "td.imdbRating strong")
  vote_tooltips <- html_attr(rating_nodes, "title")

  tibble(
    snap_year = snapshot_year,
    rank = as.integer(rank_title_parts[, 2]),
    title = rank_title_parts[, 3],
    year = as.integer(rank_title_parts[, 4]),
    rating = parse_number(html_text2(rating_nodes)),
    number = parse_number(str_extract(vote_tooltips, "[0-9][0-9,]*(?= votes)"))
  )
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(
  wayback_urls,
  wayback_years,
  fetch_imdb_snapshot
) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rank_change_data <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank, year) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = c(rank, year),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{snap_year}"
  ) |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = abs(rank_2022 - rank_2015),
    release_decade = 10 * floor(year_2015 / 10)
  )

rank_change_data |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

rank_change_data |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarise(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
snapshot_counts <- imdb_snapshots |>
  group_by(title) |>
  summarise(snapshot_count = n_distinct(snap_year), .groups = "drop")

snapshot_counts |>
  count(snapshot_count)
```

```{r}
rank_change_by_decade <- rank_change_data |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarise(
    avg_rank_change = mean(rank_2022 - rank_2015),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = factor(release_decade, levels = sort(unique(release_decade))),
    direction = if_else(avg_rank_change > 0, "Rank fell", "Rank rose")
  )

ggplot(rank_change_by_decade, aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Average change in rank from 2015 to 2022",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 rank − 2015 rank)",
    y = "Release decade",
    fill = "Direction",
    caption = "Based on 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
